excerpt: Bearconnect is a cloud LinkedIn tool that combines AI-written posts and scheduling with automated outreach campaigns. Pricing, LinkedIn's automation rules, alternatives and launch feedback.
content:
Bearconnect is a cloud-based LinkedIn tool that puts content and outreach in one place. On the content side, it drafts posts in your brand voice, schedules them on a calendar, can reply automatically to comments on a post and schedule a first comment. On the outreach side, it runs campaigns of connection requests, messages and follow-ups, withdraws stale requests, and finds warm leads such as people who engaged with your posts or a competitor's. Leads can come from LinkedIn searches, Sales Navigator, a CSV file, your connections or group members.

Version 2.0, launched on Product Hunt on 12 October 2026, is the shift from an outreach-only tool to inbound and outbound together. It added team workspaces with roles, so agencies can manage several LinkedIn accounts without sharing passwords, a Brand Voice for AI-drafted posts and inbox replies, and integrations with HubSpot, Pipedrive, Make and webhooks. It runs in the cloud without a browser extension and does not require Sales Navigator.

Bearconnect is made by Bearconnect LLC; its founder, Mona Juneja, posted the launch. It finished #10 for the day with 99 upvotes. Note that LinkedIn's own help pages say it does not permit third-party tools that automate activity on its site and that accounts using them may be restricted.

We have not tested Bearconnect ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing page and terms, LinkedIn's help centre, its Product Hunt page and the official pricing pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.starts_at: 7-day trial (card required), then $67 per LinkedIn account a month
profile.summary_short: Cloud LinkedIn tool combining AI-written posts and scheduling with automated outreach campaigns

team.name: Jamie Frausto

use_cases: Writing and scheduling LinkedIn posts in a consistent brand voice
Running connection-request and follow-up sequences from one dashboard
Turning people who engage with your posts into a prospect list
Agencies managing several clients' LinkedIn accounts with separate access
Syncing LinkedIn leads to HubSpot or Pipedrive

paragraphs: Mona Juneja first launched Bearconnect on Product Hunt as a LinkedIn outreach tool. She says a year of customer feedback showed that LinkedIn isn't only about outbound messages: people already show intent through the content they create, engage with and respond to, and Bearconnect should help capture that.

Version 2 brings inbound and outbound together, from creating and scheduling content to finding prospects from LinkedIn activity and sending requests, messages and follow-ups. She highlighted team workspaces and role-based access for agencies, AI drafts in your own brand voice, and CRM integrations.
launch_story.attribution: Mona Juneja, founder, on Product Hunt

fit: are a founder, consultant or small sales team that uses LinkedIn to find clients and wants posting and outreach in one tool
run an agency managing several clients' LinkedIn accounts
don't pay for Sales Navigator (it isn't required)
not_fit: need to stay strictly within LinkedIn's User Agreement: LinkedIn says it doesn't permit automation tools and may restrict accounts that use them
want a refund window: Bearconnect's terms say fees are non-refundable except where the law requires
want to try it without a card: the trial needs one

pricing.intro: Bearconnect charges per connected LinkedIn account, in US dollars. Paying yearly gives two months free. There are no credits or per-message charges, according to the pricing page.

plans.name: Starter
plans.price: $67 per LinkedIn account a month ($56 billed yearly, $670 a year)
plans.detail: All features: AI posts and scheduling, outreach campaigns, unified inbox, workspaces, integrations, unlimited team members

plans.name: Growth
plans.price: $285 a month for 5 LinkedIn accounts ($237 billed yearly)
plans.detail: Same features for 5 or more accounts; extra accounts $47 a month each on yearly billing; adds a consulting call, priority support and premium onboarding

plans.name: Done-For-You
plans.detail: Managed service: campaign strategy, daily connections and follow-ups, weekly reporting

notes: 7-day free trial with full access; a card is required, and you aren't charged if you cancel during the trial.
The terms say all fees are non-refundable except where required by law, and plans renew automatically.
The pricing page also showed a discount code during our check; promotions change, so check the page.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists other LinkedIn outreach tools; we compared the best-known options. Prices come from each product's own pricing page, checked on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Expandi
items.what: Cloud LinkedIn and email outreach automation
items.difference: Outreach only, without Bearconnect's AI post-writing and scheduling.

items.name: Waalaxy
items.what: LinkedIn prospecting: invitations, messages and follow-ups
items.starts_at: From €19 per user a month (see its pricing page for the billing period); 14-day trial
items.difference: Priced in euros per user with monthly invitation caps, and no content scheduling.

items.name: Taplio
items.what: LinkedIn content tool: AI post writing, scheduling and analytics
items.starts_at: Starter $39/month billed monthly; 7-day trial and 30-day money-back guarantee
items.difference: Content-first rather than outreach automation, and it offers a money-back guarantee.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt lists GetSales.io, Jeeva AI, Extrovert, La Growth Machine and Zaplify as alternatives.

liked: Team workspaces and per-account access controls for agencies
asked: What safety limits it uses given LinkedIn's stance on automation (answer: 25 connection requests and 50 messages a day, and campaigns pause near LinkedIn's weekly limit)
Whether it runs its own infrastructure or third-party providers (not directly answered)

pros: Content and outreach in one tool
Runs in the cloud; no browser extension and no need to keep a laptop on
Unlimited team members and workspaces with roles at no extra cost
CRM and automation integrations (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks)
cons: LinkedIn says it does not permit automation tools and may restrict accounts that use them
Priced per LinkedIn account, which adds up for teams
Trial requires a card, and fees are non-refundable
The founder didn't say directly whether it runs its own LinkedIn infrastructure

x.none: We found no posts about Bearconnect 2.0 on X yet.

faq.a: Starter is $67 per LinkedIn account a month, or $56 a month billed yearly. Growth is $285 a month for five accounts, or $237 billed yearly. A managed Done-For-You service is $999 a month.
Yes, 7 days with full access. A card is required; cancel during the trial and you aren't charged.

LinkedIn's help centre says it does not permit third-party software that automates activity on its site and that accounts may be restricted or shut down. Bearconnect's own terms ask users not to break LinkedIn's terms and say it is not affiliated with LinkedIn.

Its founder said on Product Hunt that it caps activity at 25 connection requests and 50 messages a day and pauses campaigns when you approach LinkedIn's weekly limit. The site also describes a dedicated IP per account and gradual warm-up. These are the company's measures, not LinkedIn approval.
No. Bearconnect works with a regular LinkedIn account, and it can import leads from Sales Navigator if you have it.
Bearconnect's terms say fees are non-refundable except where the law requires otherwise.
